rankings.pageDescription: Two views of AFC performance: live standings, and seasonal team tiers.
rankings.howItWorksDescription: Two different things, built from the same match data.
rankings.rankingsStandingsBody: A live leaderboard for teams and players, ordered by score. Monthly rankings reset on the 1st. It answers "who's #1 right now."
rankings.tiersGradeBody: Each quarter, teams are graded into four tiers (players aren't tiered). It answers "which league is my team in." A team's tier holds for the whole next quarter.
rankings.participationFloor: A team must play at least 2 tournaments in the quarter to rank above Tier 4.
rankings.pointsKills: Kills and placements from every match (compressed, so more isn't infinitely better).
rankings.pointsTournaments: Bigger tournaments multiply your points (Tier 1 x2, Tier 2 x1.5, Tier 3 x1).
rankings.pointsBonuses: Bonuses for tournament wins and reaching finals.
rankings.pointsQuarterly: Quarterly only: prize money + social following (capped).
rankings.notPublishedBody: {what} for <highlight>{season}</highlight> haven't been published yet, check back soon.
rankings.truncatedNote: This period has more entries than can be loaded at once, so the lowest-ranked ones are not shown here.
rankings.liveStandings: Live monthly standings, ordered by score
rankings.tiersIntro: Team grade for the season. Only teams are tiered.
rankings.tiersIntroTap: Tap a team for its full breakdown.
rankings.tiersComingSoon: Tiers coming soon, team grades for
rankings.noEliteYet: No teams have reached Tier 1 this season yet.
rankings.standingsAppear: Standings appear once {period} results are recorded.
rankings.loadErrorBody: Something went wrong while fetching the rankings. Check your connection and try again.
rankings.roleTabsLabel: Filter the player ladder by in-game role
rankings.roleAllCaption: Every player on the ladder, ranked overall.
rankings.roleCaption: Only players who played {role} during this period, ranked 1st, 2nd, 3rd among themselves. The role is the one they held when the points were earned, so switching role later does not move them out of a past table. Open a row to see where a player sits on the overall ladder.
rankings.roleMixedHint: This player played more than one role this period. They are listed under the role they played most. Open the row to see the split.
rankings.roleNoDataTitle: No role data for this period
rankings.roleNoDataBody: In-game roles are recorded with each match result. This period was played before that started, so there is no record of who played which role. The tabs read zero because nothing was recorded, not because nobody played those roles.
rankings.roleEmptyBody: Nobody played this role for this period. The role counted is the one a player held when the points were earned, so a player who has since switched roles stays under the role they played back then. Players with no team, staff (coach, manager, analyst) and unclaimed ghost players have no role and are not counted.

claimGhost.teamDescription: Ask an admin to map <name>this ghost</name> onto one of your teams. If approved, its history and points transfer to your team.

claimGhost.noTeamWarning: You are not the owner, captain, or a manager of any team. Only a team's manager can claim a ghost on its behalf.
claimGhost.selfClaimNote: You are claiming this ghost player as <self>yourself</self>. An admin will verify before any history moves.
claimGhost.evidencePlaceholder: Links, screenshots, or anything that helps an admin confirm this is you / your team.
claimGhost.evidenceNote: An admin reviews every claim before any results are transferred.
claimGhost.submitFailed: Failed to submit the claim. Please try again.
